query:
-- HE Lavande - Linalol
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 35.0, 1, 'stable', 'Composant principal de l''HE de lavande'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.name LIKE '%Lavande%' AND m.name LIKE '%Linalol%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- HE Menthe poivrée - Menthol
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 45.0, 1, 'stable', 'Composant principal de l''HE de menthe poivrée'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.name LIKE '%Menthe%' AND m.name LIKE '%Menthol%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- HE Eucalyptus - 1,8-Cinéole
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 70.0, 1, 'stable', 'Composant majoritaire de l''HE d''eucalyptus'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.name LIKE '%Eucalyptus%' AND (m.name LIKE '%Cinéole%' OR m.name LIKE '%Cineole%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- HE Romarin - 1,8-Cinéole

LIMIT 1;
